Traditionally, games set in Azeroth use classes. Classes are not a concept in Dragonbane. To represent the traditional classes of Azeroth, this supplement provides a set of heroic abilities. In addition to choosing a profession when creating your player character, choose one heroic class ability from this chapter that you start the game with. You must fulfill the requirement for the heroic ability you choose. You are now part of the class from which you chose a heroic ability.

When you gain heroic abilities during play, you can also choose heroic abilities from your class. You can only ever be part of one class unless your GM says otherwise. World of Warcraft limits which kin can choose certain classes. Bane of Azeroth does not impose such limitations by default, but the GM may do so, for example by limiting Demon Hunters to Elf kin.

The heroic ability gained through this chapter makes a character somewhat more powerful than a character created using only the Dragonbane core rules. It is equivalent to granting one extra heroic ability at character creation. If a campaign combines characters created with and without Bane of Azeroth, grant the other characters one extra starting heroic ability to keep them equivalent.

Death Knight

Death knights are among the most feared warriors in Azeroth's history. Created by the Lich King to serve as his most elite soldiers, death knights wield unholy magic, runic power, and the mastery of undeath that their master bestowed upon them. They are not undead in the traditional sense. They are fallen champions, raised and remade, their mortal lives extinguished and replaced with something colder and more terrible.

Over time, many death knights have broken free of the Lich King's domination, and these liberated champions now fight for their own purposes, carrying the weight of what they once were.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.death-knight.death-knights-rebirth]{Death Knight's Rebirth}

Requirement: Axes, Hammers, or Swords 12

Willpower Points: —

You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe. You know how to engrave necromantic runes into a melee weapon. Engraving a rune takes a stretch and replaces any runes you have already engraved, in the same weapon or a different one. You gain the benefits of your chosen rune listed below.

  • Fallen Crusader: Whenever you deal damage to a living creature with the weapon, you heal 1 HP.
  • Razorice: The weapon is cold to the touch, and attacks with it count as magical.
  • Unending Thirst: While wielding the weapon, your movement rate increases by 2.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.death-knight.death-grip]{Death Grip}

Requirement: Death Knight's Rebirth

Willpower Points: 2

You harness the energy that surrounds and binds all matter. If an enemy and another player character are both within 10 meters of you and the enemy tries to attack the other character, you can activate this ability to pull the enemy toward you and make it attack you instead. Using this ability can be done out of turn and does not count as an action.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.death-knight.frostreaper]{Frostreaper}

Requirement: Death Knight's Rebirth

Willpower Points: 2

By activating this ability, you emanate a frosty aura, chilling the air around you. Until your turn in the next round, any living creature that moves within 10 meters of you has its movement rate halved, and if it ends its turn within the aura, it must roll BUSHCRAFT to resist cold.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.death-knight.summon-ghoul]{Raise Ghoul}

Requirement: Death Knight's Rebirth

Willpower Points: 3

This ability requires a stretch of time to raise a fallen creature into a ravenous ghoul. The ghoul takes the form of an undead humanoid and counts as a monster in combat. It follows your commands (free action) and acts independently with its own initiative. The ghoul cannot heal HP, and it crumbles to dust and dies if it is ever out of your sight for a stretch of time, or if you use this ability again.

Demon Hunter

The demon hunters of the Illidari are among the most extreme and controversial figures in Azeroth. Trained by Illidan Stormrage himself, they sacrificed their eyes and much of their identity to consume the essence of demons, turning the Burning Legion's power against itself. They are elves, night elves and blood elves, who chose a path that most of their kin consider monstrous, and who carry that stigma alongside their extraordinary power.

Marked by their blindfolds, their tattoos, and the fel energy that burns within them, demon hunters are warriors walking a permanent razor's edge between themselves and the void they consumed.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.demon-hunter.demon-hunter-initiation]{Demon Hunter Initiation}

Requirement: Axes, Brawling, Knives, or Swords 12

Willpower Points: —

Your infernal metamorphosis gives you advantages in your hunt for demons. Your demonic wings make you glide horizontally instead of falling. Subtract your movement rate from the falling distance before determining falling damage. Your glowing eyes let you ignore the effects of darkness, and you always know whether a creature you are looking at is a demon.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.demon-hunter.eye-beam]{Eye Beam}

Requirement: Demon Hunter Initiation

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability to make your eyes shoot laser beams at a creature within 20 meters. The attack automatically hits and cannot be parried. It deals 2D8 damage and is considered magical.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.demon-hunter.live-by-the-glaive]{Live by the Glaive}

Requirement: Demon Hunter Initiation

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability (no action) when you make a successful parry to turn the roll into a dragon.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.demon-hunter.soul-cleave]{Soul Cleave}

Requirement: Demon Hunter Initiation

Willpower Points: 2

If you deal damage with an attack to a living creature, you can activate this ability (no action) to heal yourself for the same amount of HP as the target takes in damage.

Druid

The druids of Azeroth are among its oldest and most mysterious guardians. Trained in the traditions passed down from Malfurion Stormrage and the Cenarion Circle, they draw power from the natural world and from the Emerald Dream, the spiritual reflection of Azeroth as it was meant to be. Druids are shapeshifters, healers, and spellcasters, equally at home in bear form defending their allies, in cat form stalking prey through the undergrowth, or calling down starfire from the sky in the form of the moonkin.

Their connection to nature runs deep, and their patience runs deeper still.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.druid.druidic-awakening]{Druidic Awakening}

Requirement: One School of Magic

Willpower Points: —

You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.savage-incarnation]{Savage Incarnation}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory.

When you sleep, you enter a dream state that allows you to stay alert to your surroundings during a shift rest, and you can awaken instantly and at will.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.druid.chosen-of-elune]{Chosen of Elune}

Requirement: Druidic Awakening

Willpower Points: —

You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.incarnation-of-the-stars]{Incarnation of the Stars}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.druid.king-of-the-jungle]{King of the Jungle}

Requirement: Druidic Awakening

Willpower Points: —

You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.feral-incarnation]{Feral Incarnation}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.druid.tree-of-life]{Tree of Life}

Requirement: Druidic Awakening

Willpower Points: —

You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.incarnation-of-harmony]{Incarnation of Harmony}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory.

Evoker

The dracthyr evokers are something unique in Azeroth: beings created specifically to wield the combined magical legacy of all five dragonflights. Born from Neltharion's ambition, they were designed as weapons and then sealed away, only to awaken in a changed world. As evokers, they have learned to channel draconic magic through their breath, fire and frost and arcane and time and life, in ways no other spellcaster can match.

They are simultaneously ancient and new, carrying the power of dragonkind in mortal form.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.evoker.evokers-legacy]{Evoker's Legacy}

Requirement: One School of Magic

Willpower Points: —

Whenever you cast a spell at a power level higher than 1, the cost per power level is reduced to one for every level above the first (2 WP for power level 1, 3 WP for power level 2, and 4 WP for power level 3).

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.evoker.ebon-might]{Ebon Might}

Requirement: Evoker's Legacy

Willpower Points: 2

You can activate this ability when you cast a spell to give all allies within 10 meters a boon to all rolls. The boon lasts until your turn in the next round.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.evoker.rewind]{Rewind}

Requirement: Evoker's Legacy

Willpower Points: 3

You can use your action to restore your own health or an ally's health to the value it had at the start of the last round.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.evoker.tailwind]{Tailwind}

Requirement: Evoker's Legacy

Willpower Points: 1

You can activate this ability on your turn to make the DASH action a free action during that turn.

Hunter

Hunters are Azeroth's masters of the wild. They are trackers and survivalists, archers and beast tamers, operating at the boundary between civilization and the untamed places of the world. What sets a hunter apart is the bond they form with their animal companions, a relationship built on trust, training, and something deeper that defies easy explanation.

Whether they prefer to fight alongside their beasts, pick off enemies from a distance, or lay traps and engage in close-quarters combat, hunters are among the most self-sufficient fighters in all of Azeroth.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.hunter.hunters-instincts]{Hunter's Instincts}

Requirement: Companion Heroic Ability

Willpower Points: —

Your companion follows you even if you leave its natural environment. While it is within 50 meters of you, you can communicate with it telepathically. As an action, you can spend 1 WP to see through the companion's eyes and hear what it hears for one minute, gaining the benefits of any special senses it has. The WP cost for commanding the companion to attack is reduced to 2.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.hunter.aimed-shot]{Aimed Shot}

Requirement: Hunter's Instincts

Willpower Points: 3

A strike with a two-handed ranged weapon inflicts D8 additional points of damage, but you cannot move in the same round. You can activate this ability after the roll to hit, but not if you moved. This can be combined with TWIN SHOT.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.hunter.beast-master]{Beast Master}

Requirement: Hunter's Instincts

Willpower Points: 2

You can activate this ability when you or your companion is hit to transfer half the damage received (rounded down) to the other party, sharing the pain. You can do so after the roll for damage.

Alternatively, you can use an action to activate this ability to revive a fallen companion, as long as it happens within a shift of its death. If its body is within sight, it appears at the body; otherwise, it appears within 2 meters of you. It recovers1 [[/roll D6]] HP.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.hunter.superior-trapper]{Superior Trapper}

Requirement: Hunter's Instincts

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability (no action) when a non-monster creature voluntarily moves to within 2 meters of you. The creature has to make an EVADE roll, and if it fails it either takes [[/roll 2d8]] damage as it burns or loses its actions and movement for the rest of the round as it is frozen in place (your choice).

Mage

The mages of Azeroth are among the most powerful and most dangerous individuals in the world. Trained in the traditions of Dalaran and the arcane schools that predate it, they manipulate the raw fabric of reality through the force of intellect and will.

Azeroth's mages come in many forms: frost mages who encrust their enemies in ice and slow time itself, fire mages who hurl blazing pyroblasts and ignite the air around their targets, and arcane mages who ride waves of pure magical force in surging blasts of focused power. What they share is a commitment to the study of magic as a discipline, and an awareness, sometimes ignored, of the danger that comes with wielding it.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.mage.mages-brilliance]{Mage's Brilliance}

Requirement: One School of Magic

Willpower Points: —

You know the SENSE MAGIC magic trick and can cast it without spending Willpower Points. Whenever you roll for LANGUAGES, you can choose the result 10 instead of rolling.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.mage.ice-block]{Ice Block}

Requirement: Mage's Brilliance

Willpower Points: 2

You can activate this ability when you are about to take damage (no action). You become immune to damage this round and the next, including the damage that triggered this ability. For this duration, you are frozen in place and cannot move or take any actions. You can activate this ability after it has been determined that you are hit, but before the roll for damage.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.mage.living-bomb]{Living Bomb}

Requirement: Mage's Brilliance

Willpower Points: 3

When you deal damage with a spell or this ability, you can choose an additional creature within 10 meters of the target that did not take damage from that spell or this ability. That creature takes the same damage (roll separately). You can use this multiple times for the same spell casting, as long as you can pay the Willpower Points for each use.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.mage.time-warp]{Time Warp}

Requirement: Mage's Brilliance

Willpower Points: 2

You can activate this ability at the start of another player character's or NPC's turn. You swap initiative cards with that player character or NPC (or group of NPCs acting on the same turn), and it cannot refuse. A monster with multiple turns swaps only the card of the current turn with yours. You act immediately.

Monk

The monks of Azeroth walk the path of the Pandaren, a martial tradition that arrived with the opening of Pandaria and spread quickly to students across both the Horde and the Alliance. Monks blend physical discipline with the manipulation of chi, a spiritual life force that flows through all living things, to achieve extraordinary feats of combat, healing, and focus.

Brewmasters fight with an improbable combination of acrobatics and alcoholic combustion; mistweavers channel chi into restorative mists that mend wounds at a distance; windwalkers strike with devastating speed, turning the flow of a fight with a single perfectly placed blow.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.monk.monks-serenity]{Monk's Serenity}

Requirement: Brawling 12

Willpower Points: —

The damage of your unarmed attacks increases to D10. If you use IRON FIST, the damage increases to 2D10 for that unarmed attack. You can also parry both melee and ranged attacks unarmed. When parrying, you roll against your skill level for BRAWLING.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.monk.combo-strikes]{Combo Strikes}

Requirement: Monk's Serenity

Willpower Points: 3

You activate this ability on your turn in combat when performing an unarmed attack, and you can then perform two extra unarmed attacks. The second and third attacks are made with a bane. Finish the first attack, including damage, before rolling the second one, and finish the second attack, including damage, before rolling the third one.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.monk.soothing-mist]{Soothing Mist}

Requirement: Monk's Serenity

Willpower Points: 2

When you deal damage with an unarmed attack, you can activate this ability to heal another creature within 10 meters of you by the same amount.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.monk.stagger]{Stagger}

Requirement: Monk's Serenity

Willpower Points: 1

When you take damage in combat, you can activate this ability (no action). The damage is halved (rounded up). The next time you take damage in this round, you also take the damage that was reduced by this ability.

Paladin

The paladins of Azeroth are the champions of the Holy Light, warriors who have dedicated themselves to the service of faith and justice, and who wield divine power alongside their martial skill. The Light responds to belief rather than to any specific deity, making Azeroth's paladin tradition broader and more varied than it might appear.

A dwarf Vindicator of the Alliance, a Sunwalker tauren who worships An'she the sun spirit, and a blood elf Blood Knight who once stole their power from a captive Naaru are all paladins, despite their very different relationships to faith. What they share is conviction, and the power that conviction generates.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.paladin.paladins-righteousness]{Paladin's Righteousness}

Requirement: Hammers, Spears, or Swords 12

Willpower Points: —

Whenever you spend WP, you heal yourself or an ally within 2 meters by the same amount. You also always know whether a creature you are looking at is undead.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.paladin.avengers-shield]{Avenger's Shield}

Requirement: Paladin's Righteousness

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability as an action if you are wielding a shield. You hurl your shield at a creature within 10 meters, and it then bounces to a creature of your choice within 10 meters of the first target, and again to a third creature within 10 meters of the second target. It then returns to your hand. Make separate attacks with your shield against all three targets with a bane. Finish the first attack, including damage, before rolling the second one, and finish the second one, including damage, before rolling the third one. Creatures that are hit have a bane when attacking any creature other than you until your turn in the next round.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.paladin.beacon-of-light]{Beacon of Light}

Requirement: Paladin's Righteousness

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability as an action, making an allied creature within 10 meters a beacon of light. For a stretch of time, whenever you heal yourself or an ally, the beacon of light heals the same amount of HP. This ability also benefits from the HP restored by Paladin's Righteousness when activating this ability.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.paladin.blade-of-justice]{Blade of Justice}

Requirement: Paladin's Righteousness

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability when you hit an enemy with a melee weapon, but before rolling for damage. The attack deals an extra D8 damage, or 2D8 damage to an undead target, and is considered magical.

Priest

The priests of Azeroth are channelers of divine power in all its forms, from the brilliant radiance of the Holy Light to the consuming shadows of the Void. Holy priests are beacons of hope on the battlefield, mending wounds and bolstering spirits with restorative magic. Discipline priests weave protective wards and sacred power words into their spellcasting, shielding allies as they fight.

Shadow priests abandon the light entirely, plumbing the depths of the Void for destructive psychic power that corrodes the minds and bodies of their enemies. All three traditions require profound faith, though the nature of what they have faith in differs considerably.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.priest.priests-zeal]{Priest's Zeal}

Requirement: One School of Magic

Willpower Points: —

Your mind fills you with inner fire. Whenever you cast a spell, your armor rating increases by one step for each WP you spend on casting the spell. The effect lasts until your turn in the next round.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.priest.darkness]{Darkness}

Requirement: Priest's Zeal

Willpower Points: —

You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.shadowform]{Shadowform}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.priest.power-word-shield]{Power Word: Shield}

Requirement: Priest's Zeal

Willpower Points: 2

If you or a creature within 10 meters of you is hit by an attack, spell, or monster attack, you can activate this ability to shield the target. The damage the target takes from the attack or spell is reduced by [[/roll 2D6]]. Using this ability can be done out of turn and does not count as an action.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.priest.sanctify]{Sanctify}

Requirement: Priest's Zeal

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability when casting a spell that heals a creature. You and all other creatures of your choice within 10 meters heal the same amount of HP.

Rogue

Azeroth's rogues are a diverse and pragmatic lot. Whether they operate as assassins in the service of SI:7, as independent operators selling their skills to the highest bidder, or as agents of their own inscrutable agendas, rogues share a commitment to efficiency, precision, and the advantages that come from going unseen. They are the world's poisoners, infiltrators, and opportunists, and occasionally its finest practitioners of the art of the perfectly placed blade.

In a world of armies and spellcasters and ancient powers, the rogue's greatest asset is the one nobody ever expects: information.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.rogue.roguish-cunning]{Roguish Cunning}

Requirement: Knives 12

Willpower Points: —

Whenever you deal sneak attack damage to a target, the dice increase for damage is increased by two dice instead of one (for example, 3D8 instead of 2D8 for a weapon that deals D8 damage).

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.rogue.dirty-fighting]{Dirty Fighting}

Requirement: Roguish Cunning

Willpower Points: 3

This heroic ability can only be used if you wield a one-handed weapon in one hand and a one-handed ranged weapon in your other hand. The STR requirement of the weapon in your off hand (you decide whether it is right or left) increases by 3. You activate the ability on your turn in combat and can then perform an extra attack with your second weapon. The second attack is made with a bane. You decide in which order to use your two weapons. Finish the first attack, including damage, before rolling the second one.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.rogue.envenom-weapons]{Envenom Weapons}

Requirement: Roguish Cunning

Willpower Points: 2

When you hit with a piercing or slashing weapon, you can activate this ability to also apply one dose of poison that you are carrying, as if it was ingested by the target. You can activate this ability after the roll to hit.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.rogue.shadowstrike]{Shadowstrike}

Requirement: Roguish Cunning

Willpower Points: 2

You teleport up to 20 meters to a spot that you can see and may immediately take an action. If the destination is covered in shade or darkness, the action is taken with a boon. You may then teleport back to your original spot.

Shaman

The shamans of Azeroth are intermediaries between the mortal world and the elemental spirits that pervade it. They do not command the elements so much as commune with them, entering into relationships of mutual respect with the spirits of fire, water, earth, and air. Elemental shamans channel this power into devastating offensive magic, calling down lightning and lava with the blessing of the spirits they serve. Enhancement shamans fight in close combat, their weapons empowered by elemental force.

Restoration shamans heal through cascading waves of spiritual energy that leap from ally to ally, their totem-anchored magic weaving a net of protection across the battlefield.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.shaman.shamanic-calling]{Shamanic Calling}

Requirement: One School of Magic

Willpower Points: —

You know the general spell @Ref[boa:item.spells.elemental-totem]{Elemental Totem}. This spell is always prepared and does not count toward the number of spells you can hold prepared in your memory.

You do not have to roll for LANGUAGES when communicating with or trying to understand elementals or their writing.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.shaman.bloodlust]{Bloodlust}

Requirement: Shamanic Calling

Willpower Points: 3

Your howl makes your friends' blood boil. Activating this ability (an action in combat) gives all allies within 10 meters an extra action during their turn. The affected allies also become Angry, if they are not already. If an ally uses a reaction, or has already used one this round, they take their turn with no extra action, or may use another reaction. The effect lasts until your turn in the next round.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.shaman.chain-heal]{Chain Heal}

Requirement: Shamanic Calling

Willpower Points: 2

When you heal with a spell or this ability, you can choose an additional creature within 10 meters of the target that was not healed by that spell or this ability. That creature receives the same amount of healing (roll separately). You can use this multiple times for the same spell casting, as long as you can pay the Willpower Points for each use.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.shaman.stormstrike]{Stormstrike}

Requirement: Shamanic Calling

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability when you hit an enemy with a melee weapon, but before rolling for damage. The attack deals an extra D10 damage and is considered magical.

Warlock

The warlocks of Azeroth traffic in powers that most consider forbidden. Drawing on the energies of the Twisting Nether, the chaotic space between worlds where demons dwell, they bind demonic servants, curse their enemies with afflictions that fester and spread, and hurl bolts of pure fel energy with the casual confidence of those who have made their bargains and intend to collect. Warlocks are feared and distrusted across Azeroth, and for good reason.

The power they wield has a cost, though most warlocks will tell you the cost falls on someone else.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.warlock.warlocks-ambition]{Warlock's Ambition}

Requirement: One School of Magic

Willpower Points: —

When you use POWER FROM THE BODY, you get to keep any excess WP you do not use when casting the spell, up to your maximum WP.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.warlock.demonologist]{Demonologist}

Requirement: Warlock's Ambition

Willpower Points: 3

You can use your action to activate this ability to instantly summon a demon (from Appendix B in this book) into an empty space within 10 meters of you. Any demon you have already summoned using this heroic ability instantly disappears. The demon follows you for a shift at no additional WP cost. You can use its action in combat by paying the WP listed in its stat block (a free action for you). The demon can communicate with you in its demonic language, and you can both understand and speak it. The summoned demon is not necessarily the same individual you summoned previously. It is up to the GM whether the demon remembers encountering you before.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.warlock.life-drain]{Life Drain}

Requirement: Warlock's Ambition

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability when you deal damage with a spell to one creature. You regain the same amount of HP as the creature lost.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.warlock.souls-collector]{Souls Collector}

Requirement: Warlock's Ambition

Willpower Points: 1

When you or an ally deals damage that brings another non-monster creature to 0 HP, you can activate this ability (no action) to store the enemy's soul in a soul shard. You can consume a shard as an action to recover D3 WP. Any remaining soul shards are lost when you finish a shift rest.

Warrior

The warriors of Azeroth are its backbone. They are not defined by magic or by divine favor, but by the simple fact that they are better at fighting than almost anyone else alive. Arms warriors wield massive two-handed weapons with tactical precision, reading the flow of battle and delivering devastating strikes at exactly the right moment. Fury warriors enter a frenzy of dual-wielded aggression, taking hits without slowing and hitting harder for it.

Protection warriors stand like walls between their allies and whatever threatens them, using every technique in their considerable arsenal to keep enemies focused on them and away from everyone else.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.warrior.warriors-rage]{Warrior's Rage}

Requirement: Axes, Hammers, or Swords 12

Willpower Points: —

You can wield a two-handed melee weapon in one hand. This can be combined with DUAL WIELD.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.warrior.hamstring]{Hamstring}

Requirement: Warrior's Rage

Willpower Points: 2

If an enemy tries to move away from you, you can activate this ability to make the enemy automatically fail its EVADE roll. If your free attack then hits, the enemy's movement is reduced to 0 until your turn in the next round. Using this ability can be done out of turn and does not count as an action.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.warrior.retaliation]{Retaliation}

Requirement: Warrior's Rage

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability (no action) when an enemy within 2 meters of you deals damage to you with a melee attack. You immediately perform a counterattack on your opponent: an automatic hit with your weapon that cannot be dodged or parried.

@Ref[boa:item.heroic-class-ability.warrior.sunder-armor]{Sunder Armor}

Requirement: Warrior's Rage

Willpower Points: 3

You can activate this ability when you hit a creature with an attack to sunder its armor. For this attack and until your turn in the next round, the creature does not benefit from its armor rating.
